observation: Existing strategy pages publish historical outcome metrics. The e46 strategy samples cover Weeks 1–10; the 83a7 leaderboard calls Weeks 5–10 'prospective only' while its registration records are dated 2026-11-15T23:40Z. Weeks 5–9 were already played before that registration; Week 10 spans November 12–15 and its game-by-game overlap with the registration timestamp has not been audited. The combined historical window is not qualified as wholly prospective.
decision_impact: Do not rank, reward, stake from, or describe the historical leaderboard numbers as skill. The safe hub leaderboard is intentionally score-free.
clearance_rule: Remove historical figures from public leaderboard views; publish a score only for a pre-registered prospective window after all gates pass.

observation: The market desk contains aggregator-tier reference prices with no book, jurisdiction, quote timestamp or closing timestamp; all 39 originated markets have blank operator MARKET_OPEN and MARKET_CLOSE cells (0 of 78 snapshots). No qualifying official or licensed odds source is registered here.
decision_impact: Market residual, CLV, price-relative skill and real-price ROI remain undefined. Do not substitute an aggregator line for an operator quote.
clearance_rule: Select a permitted named provider and retain a timestamped opening and closing quote with rules and source for every originated market.

observation: Separate Week 10 tables in the repository contain 326 and 347 player rows; the independently published 347-row capture differs from an earlier 276-row table in 268 records. These are separate reads and are not interchangeable snapshots.
decision_impact: Availability deltas and team-level injury totals can be wrong if captures are silently combined or stale counts are reused.
clearance_rule: Choose a timestamped capture as the source of record, preserve the raw source hash, and reconcile every row against the same official page version.

observation: On the 2026-11-17 read, the requested reg11 route resolved to a page headed Week 10 (reg10). The repository has no captured Week 11 injury report from that route.
decision_impact: A Week 10 designation must not be shown as current Week 11 status; injury surprise and availability deltas are unavailable from this route.
clearance_rule: Capture the actual weekly report at each official publication time; retain its read time and a content hash.

observation: The repository contains dated injury reads, but not a retained daily Wednesday-to-kickoff series for every week. One capture is a fetch-tool transcription without a byte-for-byte page hash.
decision_impact: Questionable-to-Out changes, surprise features and point-in-time backtests cannot be replayed reliably.
clearance_rule: For each official read, store capture time, source URL, raw-content hash, schema version and conflict flags in an immutable private store; publish only permitted derivatives.

observation: The Houston club depth page is image-only. Other desk outputs use different coverage definitions: market depth_coverage reports 11 of 12 clubs parsed across 551 rows; e46 depth_slots has 702 rows across 32 club labels including one HOU row, while its earlier source log reports 700 slots across 31 clubs and team_availability marks Houston unverified/image-only and New England partial. The separate 32-row roster sweep has roster URL/count fields populated for only one row. These counts are not a verified complete structured sweep.
decision_impact: No complete 32-club replacement-depth or roster/IR graph is established; team-level personnel adjustments remain untrusted.
clearance_rule: Verify one official chart or permitted snap-count path for every club; preserve shared and empty slots; reconcile dated transactions and reserve-list events before modelling.

observation: An official Game Book route is available. The inspected PDF contains a starting lineup, a Not Active list and a snap-participation table, but its copyright statement restricts other use without written permission. No player-level Game Book rows were imported into this hub.
decision_impact: Actual starters, game-day inactives and snap-share replacements cannot be published from this source until reuse rights are resolved.
clearance_rule: Obtain written permission or a licensed/authorized source, then store raw evidence privately and publish only an allowed derived table.

observation: A dated schedule-release announcement and the live Week 11 schedule are now paired on this hub. The existing venue table has 13 rows, 12 named values and a schedule/ticket-hotel-destination method rather than a per-fixture Game Center source; every row carries OWN-56 and one venue value is blank. The sampled Colts–Texans Game Center publishes the stadium label “Reliant Stadium”; preserve that text exactly and flag the apparent discrepancy rather than silently normalizing it.
decision_impact: The requirement to source every venue from that fixture's official Game Center remains partial; a schedule listing alone is not the requested evidence.
clearance_rule: For each fixture, store its own NFL Game Center URL and copy the venue field only from that page; leave any unreadable venue blank.

observation: Two overlapping decision-readiness datasets are published: one has 78 rows and the e46 desk has 72. No verified row-by-row mapping is recorded, so counts and statuses should not be added together.
decision_impact: A combined completion percentage would be misleading until duplicate wording and scopes are mapped.
clearance_rule: Freeze one versioned requirement register and document a one-to-one or one-to-many mapping for every legacy row.

observation: Multiple public static desks expose row-level injury and depth data. The Game Book reuse terms were not previously recorded; this hub does not copy the Game Book rows and marks raw-data publication as blocked pending terms review.
decision_impact: Public data should be limited to permitted derived analysis until source terms and retention rights are reviewed.
clearance_rule: Record source terms and permissions; keep raw row-level captures in a private store and publish only allowed aggregates and official links.

observation: Official standings-based team correlations are published with n, but player-prop, same-game and other joint correlations are withheld where official matched inputs or joint probabilities are missing.
decision_impact: A marginal correlation or product of marginal probabilities cannot qualify a parlay or prop combo.
clearance_rule: Keep each published statistic attached to its official input source and n; admit a combo only after its joint probability and settlement rules are directly validated.

observation: The dated May 8 league announcement and official live schedule page were read and paired on this hub. The existing schedule_announcements.csv still contains later flexible-scheduling notes, not this full-schedule release announcement.
decision_impact: The hub now meets the discoverability part of the requirement; the canonical desk data register is not yet synchronized.
clearance_rule: Add the same two official links and publication date to the canonical schedule-announcement register in an authorized integration change.
